title: SDK + Quickstart Velocity Harness: experimental playbook and measurement plan
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description:
Purpose: Build a repeatable, measurable playbook (the 'Velocity Harness') for running fast experiments that convert developer sign-ups into production SDK integrations using short quickstarts and sample apps. This initiative focuses on three levers: a) reducing first-success time in quickstarts, b) providing a small catalog of high-quality reference apps for common stacks, and c) instrumenting conversion and health signals to tie experiments to OKRs.

Scope: 1) A 3-step quickstart template with opinionated defaults (Node, Python, and a CLI example). 2) Two reference sample apps (chat widget + background ingestion) with copy-ready prompts and tests. 3) A measurement plan surfaced in Console and looker: key events, funnel, attribution for experiment cohorts. 4) A lightweight playbook documenting experiment runbook, rollout, rollback criteria, and required analytics queries.
success_criteria: Reduce median time-to-first-success (TTFS) for quickstart from 22 minutes to <=8 minutes for 50% of new signups
Increase SDK activation rate (first tokenized request within 24h) by +12 percentage points in experiment cohorts
Ship 2 reference apps with automated smoke tests and example prompts in repo
Measurement plan validated and dashboarded in Console for cycle end
